title: High temperature in adults
text: In adults, a temperature of 38 degrees Celsius or higher is generally described as a fever. Body temperature varies between people and over the day. Feeling hot or shivery can matter even when a reading is lower.

title: Cough and possible causes
text: A cough can occur with a cold or flu, allergies, reflux or other conditions. A cough alone does not establish a diagnosis. NHS guidance recommends medical review for a persistent cough lasting more than three weeks.

title: Shortness of breath
text: Breathlessness has many possible causes. Treatment depends on the cause, so symptoms should not be used to self-diagnose. Severe breathing difficulty, such as gasping or being unable to get words out, requires immediate medical help.

title: Unknown answers and uncertainty
text: Not sure means that the symptom has not been confirmed or denied. It is stored separately and is not passed to recall as negative evidence. A user may correct this status later using the evidence panel.

title: Correcting a symptom
text: The evidence panel lets the user change a symptom to Present, Absent or Not sure. Corrections replace current evidence while retaining history. The application then recalculates candidate results using the updated evidence.

title: Why the chatbot asks a follow-up question
text: In random mode a seeded simulation selects an unanswered symptom from the full catalog. In mock mode questions follow a fixed fixture order for integration testing. In remote mode the teammate search module selects the next question. Asking about a symptom does not mean the user has that symptom or a particular disease.

title: Scores and diagnostic probabilities
text: Candidate scores are ranking values returned by the selected adapter. They are not calibrated disease probabilities. Mock candidates and scores are fixtures; they do not describe the user's health.

title: Session storage and deletion
text: This local academic application stores conversations in a SQLite database. Use fictional data. Delete and start over removes the selected conversation and request replay records. JSON export downloads a copy that the user manages separately.

title: System scope and limitations
text: This academic prototype demonstrates NLP, dialogue state and algorithm integration. It is not clinically validated and does not diagnose conditions or prescribe medication. Retrieval and informed search are teammate modules; local mode uses labelled fixtures.
